description.value: The Central BC Railway & Forestry Museum sits at the confluence of the Nechako and Fraser Rivers in Prince George, preserving rail and forest industrial heritage from Northern Interior BC on the ancestral territory of the Lheidli T'enneh Nation. Its collection spans locomotives, rolling stock, and heritage railway buildings from lines including the Grand Trunk Pacific, Canadian National, and BC Rail, most of which visitors can board and explore. A touring cyclist passing through Prince George will find a richly immersive outdoor and indoor heritage experience with programming ranging from school field trips to facility rentals and seasonal special events.
